title: Sleeps 12 | Hot Tub | Near Airport & Downtown
description:
Beautiful home situated on a serene 3.5-acre lot in a peaceful neighborhood, just outside downtown Nashville and close to the airport, featuring a tranquil creek and majestic trees at the end of a cul-de-sac. The property boasts three spacious living areas, four full bathrooms, a steam room, & a jacuzzi tub. Enjoy a wealth of amenities including a hot tub, fire pit, a large projector screen movie room, a pool table, foosball table, dartboards (2), Golden Tee, karaoke, cornhole, and much more.

Other things to note
This spacious home is ideal for large groups, business gatherings, or family get-togethers. You’ll find a variety of entertainment options at your disposal, including a pool table, foosball table, ring toss game, dart boards & a projector for movie nights. Additionally, enjoy Golden Tee, cornhole, a croquet set, a charming porch swing, and multiple hammocks outside. There’s also a cozy fire pit and a plethora of board games to keep everyone entertained.

With the addition of a tankless hot water heater, you can enjoy endless hot showers throughout your stay.

I’m always here to help ensure you have a fantastic experience!
